scope: Structural and modular-algebra classification only: primitive integer casts and exact core integer identity calls are stripped from both trees; compound assignments to local names or their fields are expanded; associative integer operators and mixed addition/subtraction are reassociated without operand reordering; addition of a negative integer constant becomes subtraction. Parentheses are removed in the AST while other operator nesting remains. The same-width primitive guards and wrapping arithmetic are required for the algebraic classification.
